label: B · Mid frontend (React, TypeScript)
cvText:
Frontend developer with 4 years of professional experience building web applications for SaaS products.

Skills: React, TypeScript, Next.js, Redux Toolkit, React Query, Tailwind CSS, Jest and React Testing Library, Storybook, Cypress, GraphQL clients, accessibility (WCAG), performance optimization with Lighthouse and Web Vitals.

Experience: led the migration of a legacy JavaScript dashboard to React and TypeScript; built a design system used by three product teams; mentored two junior developers.

Languages: Spanish (native), English (C1).

Looking for a mid-level remote frontend or full-stack role with a React focus.
